facts.fact: A Google with Millward Brown study, cited by StackAdapt, found that 75% of donors turn to online resources to look for information about a cause.
facts.quote: “75% of donors turn to online resources to look for information, and 76% of donors go online to research in less than a week after viewing an ad”

facts.fact: A Google with Millward Brown study, cited by StackAdapt, found that 76% of donors go online to research a cause in less than a week after viewing an ad.
facts.quote: 76% of donors go online to research in less than a week after viewing an ad

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that donors typically take about two weeks researching a cause before performing an action such as making a donation (vendor's own claim, no source given).
facts.quote: Donors typically take about two weeks researching a cause before performing an action such as making a donation.
